name: poly
description: Zero-dependency lint & format orchestrator over MCP — one pure-Rust binary wrapping ruff/oxc/taplo/rumdl and more as in-process backends, plus a tree-sitter generic tier for everything else. Exposes lint/format/cache tools with structured JSON output.

interface.shortDescription: Zero-dependency lint & format orchestrator over MCP
interface.longDescription: poly is a single pure-Rust binary that lints and formats a whole repository across languages — wrapping ruff/oxc/taplo/rumdl and more as in-process backends, with a tree-sitter generic tier for everything else. Its MCP server exposes lint/format/cache tools with structured JSON output. Per-file engines run in-process; optional native and workspace toolchains can run subprocesses.
defaultPrompt: Lint this repository with poly and summarize the findings.
Check formatting drift with poly and list the affected files.
Apply poly's lint and format autofixes, then report what remains.
Show poly's effective configuration for this repo.
